event: US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED, likely 15:30 SAST). No high-impact US release left today (Forexuro).

bullets.title: Back at 4,000
bullets.text: Gold was 4,002 at 19:37 SAST, down 29.80 (-0.74%), and dipped to 3,997.70 after topping at 4,067.90 this morning (Kitco).

bullets.title: Supports broken
bullets.text: This afternoon price fell through the morning low near 4,026 and Tuesday's low near 4,013, so both now sit overhead.

bullets.title: Dollar stronger
bullets.text: The dollar index is up 0.68% near 102.93 and the US yield Trading Economics lists is near 4.99% (tenor UNVERIFIED), which weighs on gold.

bullets.title: Hike talk grows
bullets.text: Trading Economics says Waller floated a 50 bp hike as early as December, and its December hike odds range from 91% to 100% (sources differ, UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hot CPI backdrop
bullets.text: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m against 0.3% expected, which started this week's selling (Trading Economics, Mitrade).

bullets.title: 4,000 in focus
bullets.text: Kitco headlines 'solid support at 4,000', so a clean break below it is the key test tonight.
